title: Final Universal local/static implementation coverage
scope: WU-00 171 requirement rows reviewed against current repository; no historical BLOG-DOC PDFs or audits used as target authority
limitations: No live PostgreSQL, browser, Docker image, DNS, Coolify runtime, or deployment proof.
Repository-wide Ruff and root format findings predate WU-07 and are reported in the final gate.

requirements.requirement: Retain exactly one Central Admin application for GLOBAL and SITE workspaces.
Retain one reusable Website Dashboard/Site Workspace implementation for N SiteContexts.
Create one target Universal Public Frontend codebase/image that renders all tenants by authoritative Host/SiteContext.
Keep one shared FastAPI API architecture; do not create per-site API instances or codebases.
Keep one shared worker system and existing worker profiles; no per-site workers.
Keep one shared PostgreSQL platform with site_id ownership and FORCE RLS as tenant data authority.
Keep shared Redis, OpenSearch, MinIO/object storage, and existing security-state architecture.
Enforce WEBSITE != APPLICATION: a website is tenant identity/settings/content/navigation/media/permissions/presentation/domains.
Universal Frontend = fixed ready-made functional core + controlled visual configuration; never a page builder.
Forbid arbitrary HTML, CSS, JS, JSX/React, arbitrary components/templates/imports/font URLs in tenant presentation/content configuration.
Keep all 14 legacy public apps/services during implementation as reference, parity and rollback targets; do not delete them in coding phase.
Use source-of-truth order: current repo -> audits 1-14 -> current owner target decisions; old original PDFs cannot override.
requirements.notes: Owner authority reset supersedes WU-00 audit-order wording. This review used current four authorities and repository evidence; no audits or historical PDFs were target authority.

requirements.requirement: Implementation pack authorizes code updates/local validation only; no live deployment, DNS, production DB operation, traffic cutover, or live Coolify mutation.
requirements.notes: This is a local/static gate. No live operations were performed.

requirements.requirement: Future SITE-N must not create a per-site frontend app, Dashboard app, API, database, or Docker/Coolify frontend service.
Preserve public authority chain Host -> Domain -> trusted SiteContext -> site_id -> transaction -> FORCE RLS; frontend config never selects tenant.
Final GLOBAL launch navigation exposes Dashboard, Websites/Sites & Domains, Admin Users, Audit, Platform Settings; Roles/Permission Registry stay hidden from normal launch navigation.
Global Dashboard remains simple/high-level: total/active/disabled-testing sites, recent sites/activity, high-level platform status; no cross-site editorial CMS.
Canonical Create Website route remains GLOBAL `/global/sites/new`.

Create Website flow order: Identity -> 5 styles or Custom -> customization -> visual preview -> review/confirm -> atomic provisioning -> temp Host -> readiness -> existing Dashboard -> configure/test -> production domain later.
Expose exactly five user-facing Ready-made Website Styles: Modern Magazine, Classic Editorial, Minimal Clean, Bold News, Warm / Spiritual Editorial.
Expose Start Custom and allow customization of a selected ready-made style using approved controls only.
Appearance selection is visual-first with thumbnails/representative previews; internal IDs are not primary UX.
Provide two preview levels: in-Admin representative appearance preview before provisioning, and real temporary-host Universal site after provisioning/enablement.
Add Appearance inside reusable SITE workspace, conceptually `/site/:siteKey/appearance`; do not create a new Admin app.

Appearance UI covers Ready-made Styles, Custom Appearance, Branding, Colors, Typography, Cards, Hero, Homepage style, Article style, Collection style, Image treatment, global tokens, conditional Button/CTA, Information Pages, visual preview, and open-temp-site action.
Do not expose Header or Footer structural profile selectors in V1; one fixed shell consumes runtime content/branding/tokens.
Provide controlled editor for exactly five information pages: About, Contact, Privacy, Terms, Disclaimer.
Reuse existing `site_settings.view/edit` authority for Appearance and fixed information pages; do not add `appearance.*` or new page permission family in V1.
Production/canonical domain management remains GLOBAL/Super-Admin-only and never appears in ordinary Site Workspace/Appearance.
SITE workspace remains editorial/site-local: posts, categories, tags, authors, media, nav/home, appearance, SEO, redirects, search, calendar, settings.
Keep ordinary-user assigned-sites landing selector and server-side assignment denial; extend only so future sites can appear when assigned.
Do not create role-specific dashboards; Super Admin, FWM and CE use same Site Dashboard with permission-filtered actions.
Audit is explicitly visible in final GLOBAL launch UX; this supersedes older hide-Audit launch notes.
Keep Platform Settings but render structured controls rather than raw JSON-style editing.
Keep Global All Posts non-primary and do not expand it into cross-site editorial management.
Never expose an Appearance control unless UI -> type -> OpenAPI -> validation -> auth -> persistence -> PageData -> renderer -> responsive fallback -> tests all exist.
Custom palette UI uses semantic color pickers with visible contrast validation errors; invalid combinations cannot save.
Image-based category-card choices remain hidden/unavailable until a real end-to-end category-image contract exists; do not add such contract in V1 solely for appearance.
Header CTA is optional/default OFF and only exposed if existing structured navigation can support a validated same-site destination end-to-end; otherwise keep control hidden.
requirements.notes: Header CTA Appearance control remains hidden pending end-to-end structured destination support.

requirements.requirement: Create only a new migration after DB-MIG-019; never edit DB-MIG-001..019.
Extend existing RLS-protected `site_settings` with validated presentation/static-page fields (e.g. presentation_schema_version, presentation_config JSONB, static_pages JSONB).
Do not add `site_presentations` table in V1.
Do not add `site_static_pages` table in V1.
Do not add `SETUP` lifecycle state in V1; retain ACTIVE, DISABLED, ARCHIVED, DELETION_REQUESTED.
Generalize contract/application site-key validation beyond fixed SITE-01..SITE-14 using repository-consistent grammar compatible with DB `^SITE-[0-9]{2,}$`.

Define canonical PresentationConfig contract covering ready-made style, branding, palette, typography, layout tokens, cards, hero, homepage, article, collections, button/CTA; intentionally no Header/Footer structural profile fields.
Define validated static_pages contract for exactly ABOUT, CONTACT, PRIVACY, TERMS, DISCLAIMER with enabled/version/title/intro/body_sections structure.
Custom palette contract supports semantic tokens only; no freeform style strings.
Schema forbids raw CSS/selectors/style strings/HTML/JS/JSX/React/arbitrary font URLs/component names/import paths/server templates.
Presentation fallback chain is stored config -> validate version/IDs -> selected preset defaults -> platform SAFE_DEFAULT; never another tenant config.
Referenced media/navigation IDs in presentation settings must be same-site validated server-side.
Extend common public PageData envelope to include trusted presentation alongside context/site/settings/navigation/SEO/page payload.
Unknown Host responses must not fabricate known-site PageData/presentation envelope.
Define Create Website request/response/readiness contract sufficient for one server-owned atomic provisioning operation.
Regenerate canonical TS contract/admin/public clients deterministically after OpenAPI changes; downstream units consume generated artifacts and do not hand-edit them.
Correct launch role definitions: CE gets `tags.view`; FWM gets `tags.view/create/edit/delete`.
Lifecycle enum/contract remains existing four site statuses; Admin eligibility behavior changes in backend, not enum expansion.
Provision homepage baseline using exact existing registry keys/kinds/contract versions discovered from repository; do not invent a parallel homepage schema.
requirements.notes: Current Universal V1 baseline is two contract-owned rows: featured-posts and featured-categories, not a legacy row set.

requirements.requirement: Do not introduce category-image DB/API fields solely to unlock image card variants in V1.
Temporary hostname is an ordinary explicit domain mapping tied to the same site_id; production domain promotion changes address/canonical state, not tenant identity.
Readiness is computed response/state, not a new durable lifecycle value.
Replace row-only Create Site with one backend-owned all-or-nothing provisioning transaction.
Allow authorized Super Admin/assigned users to configure DISABLED sites through Admin SiteContext according to permissions.
Keep DISABLED public sites fail-closed.
When temporary-site whole-site testing is explicitly enabled via existing lifecycle, temporary-host output is publicly reachable but forced noindex/crawler-disallow; noindex is not privacy.
Decouple Admin site lookup/configuration from requirement for an active canonical domain while preserving public Host/domain authority.
Public API resolves tenant strictly from incoming Host/domain mapping to trusted SiteContext; no client-selected site_id authority or default tenant.
Unknown/unregistered Host returns neutral response with no tenant identity/theme/navigation/canonical metadata.
Known-site 404/410 retain tenant PageData/shell context and correct HTTP semantics.
Project validated public site identity/settings/navigation/presentation/SEO into PageData under authoritative SiteContext.
Repair existing SEO wiring: Admin/runtime title and meta naming, stored post/category/author SEO consumption, post OG image, default social image, dedicated social/Twitter projection as supported.
Implement article SEO precedence: post-specific -> content fallback -> site defaults -> generated fallback; OG image: post OG -> featured -> site default social -> none.
Expose/serve Host-aware robots.txt, sitemap.xml and sitemap resources using existing crawler/sitemap architecture where repository currently lacks proven HTTP serving.
Remove exact-two-digit SITE parser assumptions from media/preview/runtime paths without weakening ownership/grant checks.
Preserve existing Preview authority (single-use handoff, host/site/post/source binding, secure session, no-store/no-referrer/noindex, media grants).
Keep OpenSearch derived/site-aware; future site creation must not create a new OpenSearch service and zero-doc sites are valid.
Keep Redis/cache keys tenant-aware; any Universal page/render cache must include authoritative Host/Site identity, never pathname alone.
Workers remain shared and carry/revalidate site-aware job context; presentation changes never create per-site workers.
Generate/register temporary Host only during actual provisioning after owner confirmation; no pre-creation temporary domain for appearance preview.
Provision site row, locale/timezone, site_settings, presentation/static defaults, HEADER/FOOTER menus, homepage baseline, temp domain, audit event and readiness in transaction.
Rollback all mandatory provisioning DB changes on any failure; Admin must not orchestrate partial multi-call provisioning.
Run site-aware search/index/bootstrap work post-commit only if current adapters actually require it; do not invent synthetic per-site infra.
Production domain add/verify/promote uses existing GLOBAL domain authority and immediately drives canonical SEO through same site_id/domain model.
Enforce corrected tag capabilities server-side, not merely in UI.
Fixed information pages read from site_settings.static_pages; disabled/missing page returns known-site 404; unknown Host stays neutral.
If Header CTA is supported, validate it as a same-site enabled navigation destination; do not invent an arbitrary CTA URL/HTML model.
requirements.notes: Header CTA remains hidden/default off because stable structured navigation binding is unavailable.

requirements.requirement: Create proposed `apps/public-universal` (or repository-convention equivalent only if concretely required) as one Pages Router/SSR Universal app.
Preserve one Universal route tree for Home, Article, Category, Tag, Author, Search, five information pages, Preview, catch-all, 404/410/system/framework states.
Universal SSR reads incoming Host, forwards effective Host to API, handles redirect/status/cache/preview, and fails closed on transport/contract errors.
Remove compiled `EXPECTED_SITE_KEY` and `EXPECTED_DOMAIN` checks only in Universal app; legacy apps remain untouched as references.
Implement one Universal SiteShell with fixed Universal Header and fixed Universal Footer for trusted known-site pages.
Fixed Header contains BrandIdentity, PrimaryNavigation, SearchEntry, optional validated CTA slot default OFF, MobileNavigation; no structural selector.
Header renders ordered enabled nav and supported child items through one accessible dropdown/expand behavior; no arbitrary menu HTML.
Search page/functionality is fixed core and Header provides search access; it is not a per-site app feature toggle.
Logo uses site media or display-name fallback; Header mobile behavior/focus/Escape/aria/touch/overflow/contrast are deterministic and accessible.
Fixed Footer contains brand, navigation, social/contact, legal in deterministic semantic order; no structural selector.
Footer omits missing optional groups cleanly, keeps valid minimal known-site shell, stacks accessibly on small screens, and never borrows another tenant.
Known-site 404/410 use site shell/presentation; unknown Host and untrusted transport/contract failures use neutral system surface.
Render secure Preview through same Universal article/shell/presentation engine without becoming Preview authority.
Universal SeoHead consumes corrected trusted backend SEO projection; frontend does not guess canonical site from appearance config.
Theme/presentation mapping is request-local with no tenant-global mutable singleton/state leakage.
Universal renderer has no default-tenant fallback and never uses previous request/another site presentation on invalid data.
Consolidate existing common semantic components and 12-block renderer rather than redesigning them for cosmetic reasons.
Foundation respects shared responsive classes MOBILE <768, TABLET 768-1199, DESKTOP >=1200 and allows safe container queries without tenant-configured breakpoints.
Implement/organize the 40-component Universal design catalogue as shared engines/primitives, not one codebase per profile.
Support 30 approved ArticleCard profiles with specified fallback/compatibility rules; profiles are config over shared renderer.
Support 26 approved Hero/Featured treatments over the same lead data; no profile may require undeclared data.
Define/support 25 category-card treatments only to extent data exists; image-based variants remain unavailable in Admin without end-to-end category imagery.
requirements.notes: Image-dependent category treatments remain catalogue-known but unavailable without category image data.

requirements.requirement: Support 25 approved AuthorCard/AuthorProfile treatments with safe avatar/monogram fallback.
requirements.notes: AUTH-12 is catalogue-known but unavailable; it safely falls back to AUTH-05 because public total count is absent.

requirements.requirement: Support 25 curated Homepage compositions as configuration of shared section primitives, never separate home page files.
Support 16 controlled Article-layout profiles over existing article content/data.
Support 12 Collection layouts for category/tag/author/search collections.
Provide 28 code-owned typography presets with safe fallback stacks/weights/scales/line-height/letter-spacing; no arbitrary font URLs.
Only expose typography presets whose loaded stacks correctly support site script/locale; preserve Devanagari-capable behavior for Hindi-first sites.
Provide 30 palette presets including exact first-14 parity-source principal tokens and platform semantic status tokens.
Validate all selectable/custom palette usages for text, large text, focus, inverse/button contrast; invalid mappings are unavailable/rejected.
Support 12 controlled Button/CTA visual profiles; maintain touch/contrast/focus requirements.
Support 12 controlled image treatments; article-body media stays intrinsic/contained and is not silently cropped by card settings.
Support code-owned density systems COMPACT/STANDARD/SPACIOUS/AIRY with readability minimums overriding compactness.
Support radius systems SQUARE/SUBTLE/MEDIUM/SOFT/ROUND with semantic exceptions such as circular avatars.
Support border systems NONE/HAIRLINE/STANDARD/ACCENT-EDGE/RULE-DRIVEN as code-owned tokens.
Support elevation systems FLAT/LOW/MEDIUM/FLOATING; no Admin-entered box-shadow strings.
Support container systems 760/960/1120/1200/1280/1360 capped variants; article measure remains independent.
Implement internal 42-recipe compatibility registry as configuration/composition only; it must not create 42 apps/pages/services or expose invalid combinations.
Implement the exact five user-facing ready-made styles as starting configs mapped to internal palette/type/home/hero/card/article/collection/image/token defaults.

Create 14 legacy parity starting configurations using locked palette/type/home/article/card/collection/density/container/radius mapping; fixed Universal shell replaces legacy structural shell differences.
Keep Header/Footer reference catalogues internal/reference-only; do not make runtime structural options or persist header/footer profile IDs.
Homepage keeps current runtime content model (intro, optional lead, POST_SELECTION, CATEGORY_SELECTION, TOGGLE_ONLY, latest) and separates content selection from visual presentation.
Support seven homepage layout families and four lead variants, controlled card/grid/density/image/spacing behavior, and prescribed empty-section/latest fallbacks.
Article retains exact 12 structured block types and content structure; no arbitrary new blocks/HTML; tables/media keep safe responsive behavior.
Support controlled Article presentation fields for layout, measure, headline scale, meta layout, featured-media ratio, author and related-content presentation.
Render article SEO/OG structured metadata using backend precedence and canonical authority.
Category and Tag share one collection renderer with GRID/LIST/MAGAZINE/COMPACT semantics, intentional empty states, pagination and site-scoped queries.
Author page keeps identity/avatar fallback/designation/bio/expertise/articles/pagination and shares presentation system; no private fields.
Search keeps NO_QUERY/EMPTY/RESULTS/pagination semantics and site-scoped backend search; no client-selected tenant index.
Render five fixed information pages through controlled common page engine using site_settings.static_pages; no arbitrary HTML/forms/scripts.
Implement Preview/404/410/system-state page contracts with correct status/noindex/known-site shell vs neutral unknown-host behavior.
Responsive grids reduce safely (4-><=2->1/2, 3->2->1, 2->2/1->1); large split layouts stack when minimum width fails.
Mobile interactive targets are at least 44 CSS px where applicable; focus visible; hover is never sole affordance.
Article tables use controlled horizontal scroll with header semantics; images use existing responsive variants and article-body images are not globally cropped.
Centralize design option IDs/display metadata so Admin and Universal renderer share one authoritative vocabulary; do not duplicate divergent ID lists.
During repository migration state keep site-01..site-14 services/builds available and add Universal public build/service beside them; no live routing change.
Final target is one Universal frontend image/logical multi-host service (with N identical replicas if needed), not one public service per tenant.
Do not remove legacy 14 services/apps during these work units; removal belongs to later accepted live migration.
Add/register Universal frontend Docker/build/workspace/turbo/package configuration using repo conventions.
Future site creation must not depend on `SITE_01_TIMEZONE`...`SITE_14_TIMEZONE` or other exact-14 bootstrap environment variables; legacy fresh-seed compatibility may remain.
Generalize exact-estate tooling/scripts/fixtures/search/bootstrap parsers that enumerate only 14 sites while preserving site-aware behavior.
Do not implement live wildcard DNS/TLS/provider operations in code-update phase; repository may define configurable preview-base-domain inputs only where needed.
Existing 14 sites require no new creation flow and remain existing tenants; use them for visual/content/SEO/Preview/responsive parity checks later.
Recognizable legacy identity is preserved via runtime parity configs/tokens/page recipes, not duplicated shell branches.
Do not push/commit/deploy unless a later explicit owner instruction authorizes it; this pack focuses on repository working-tree code updates and local validation.
requirements.notes: Current WU-07 explicitly forbids commit/push/deploy; earlier checkpoint commits were owner-authorized.

requirements.requirement: Every user-facing Appearance option must be proven end-to-end across contract, backend, persistence, PageData, renderer, responsive fallback and automated tests.
Verify tenant isolation remains Host/SiteContext/site_id/FORCE-RLS based for new site_settings fields and all new runtime paths.
Verify OpenAPI/runtime/generated clients are consistent and no generated client is hand-edited.
Verify DB-MIG-001..019 are byte-unchanged and new migration is forward-only after 019.
Add/verify SITE-15 and SITE-100 (or equivalent future-site fixtures) contract/parser/provisioning coverage without new app/service.
Verify unknown Host has neutral response and never falls back to SITE-01; known-site 404/410 keep correct site shell/status.
Verify Preview handoff/session/site/post/host/media/no-store/noindex security remains intact through Universal frontend.
Verify CE/FWM/Super Admin permission behavior for tags, Appearance, fixed pages and domain-management separation.
Verify exactly five user-facing styles + Custom, visual-first selection, no Header/Footer structural selector, and no technical-ID-first UX.
Verify invalid custom palette/config IDs/raw-code fields are rejected or safely defaulted according to locked validation/fallback rules.
Verify image-based category choices are not exposed unless end-to-end category imagery exists; V1 default is hidden.
Verify Universal V1 has one fixed Header and one fixed Footer structure and PresentationConfig persists no structural profile IDs.
Search repository for fixed SITE-01..SITE-14/exact-two-digit assumptions; every remaining occurrence must be either legacy-reference/seed compatibility or documented intentional.
Verify all 14 legacy apps remain available/buildable/referenceable and are not silently deleted/rewritten.
requirements.notes: All 14 legacy packages passed typecheck and tests; build outcome recorded separately in WU-07 final report.

requirements.requirement: Verify Universal frontend builds once and has no site-specific business switch/compiled expected identity.
Verify SEO fixes: stored SEO consumption, OG/default social precedence, canonical domain authority, temporary noindex, crawler endpoints, social metadata.
Verify Desktop/Tablet/Mobile, keyboard/focus/touch, table overflow, media crop and Devanagari/typography constraints for selectable visual options.
Verify provisioning is transactionally complete, rolls back on failure, produces readiness, and creates no per-site infrastructure.
Cross-check all final lock summary items and architecture-change-ledger decisions against implemented tree before completion.
Run only practical local/static validation available in repository (typecheck/lint/unit/contract/build/migration/static tests); no live VPS/Coolify/DNS/browser acceptance required in this phase.
requirements.notes: Local/static evidence only. Root formatting and broad Ruff baseline failures are recorded separately; live acceptance is not claimed.

validation_commands_by_prefix.ADM: corepack pnpm --filter @bp/admin test; corepack pnpm --filter @bp/admin typecheck; corepack pnpm --filter @bp/admin build
validation_commands_by_prefix.UF: corepack pnpm --filter @bp/public-universal test; corepack pnpm --filter @bp/public-universal typecheck; corepack pnpm --filter @bp/public-universal build
validation_commands_by_prefix.DS: corepack pnpm --filter @bp/presentation-catalogue test; corepack pnpm --filter @bp/public-universal test
validation_commands_by_prefix.QA: uv run --frozen --all-packages python -m pytest -q; corepack pnpm --filter @bp/admin test; corepack pnpm --filter @bp/public-universal test
